records.issue_text: Removed zodError logging means invalid Office365 token responses fail silently; failure is swallowed and stale credentials get persisted
records.rationale: In `Office365CalendarService`, zod error logging was removed, but invalid token responses no longer “fail silently”: the new `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)` throws `Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` if validation fails. There is no try/catch swallowing this, so the request errors out and does not proceed to persist stale credentials.
